name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Technical Implementation & Client Onboarding | Configuration, Data Mapping & Project Management
summary: Implementation and client onboarding lead with 15+ years across SaaS, agency, and operations roles, taking clients from signed contract to live, validated systems. At Wix, onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month at 110% of implementation targets and led a team of 20 onboarding specialists. At Accelo, scoped CRM and project-management implementations, built sequenced implementation plans, and supported API integrations and workflow design. Configures platforms hands-on (Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Zapier/Make/n8n), defines data fields and mappings, tests workflows before go-live, and documents every decision so the operations handoff is clean.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead end-to-end implementations of new technology stacks, gathering client requirements and translating them into platform configuration, integrations, and hands-on user training.
Configured and deployed 20+ integrated workflows in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, including lead routing, booking, and data sync, testing each workflow end to end before activation.
Build integrations across CRMs and tools in Zapier, Make, and n8n, including custom Python and JavaScript code steps to map and transform data between systems.
Maintain contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and strict data-hygiene protocols so client data stays complete and validated.
Document every interaction, timeline, configuration, and deliverable in Notion and the CRM, keeping project records auditable across concurrent implementations.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Coordinated multi-department delivery for multi-stakeholder accounts, keeping implementation quality consistent and resolving client feedback quickly.
Built reporting frameworks and ran QBRs, translating performance data into recommendations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of listings-syndication, reputation, and marketing automation tools across a 15-20 partner network.
Ensured every partner's end customer had an accurately configured local-listings data presence, the core of the product offering.
Built automated onboarding and product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction, retaining all but one partner (~94% retention).
Delivered structured, prioritized implementation feedback to Product and Engineering, and tracked accounts in Salesforce.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for two years (20, later 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for onboarding and outbound workflows in Salesforce, standardizing data capture across the team.
Advised on A/B test structure and success criteria for a Salesforce workflow-automation effort.
Delivered launches on time as primary contact, accelerating time-to-value.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Scoped CRM and project-management implementations for agencies and professional-services firms, building sequenced implementation plans that ranked which systems to change and in what order, then handing them to the implementation team.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations alongside implementation teams, troubleshooting technical issues during setup.
Escalated implementation risks to leadership early and built Zapier automations along the way.

experience.title: Co-Owner / Operations Lead
bullets: Built operational infrastructure from scratch for a state-licensed, regulated business: compliance systems, intake processes, reporting, and vendor and supplier workflows.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
